comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Item 0 needs a comment that explicitly quotes or near-verbatim reproduces a specific factual claim from the OP and then refutes it. Quoting is required, and opinion or value claims don't count. Item 77 needs a comment that challenges an underlying assumption or premise, and it excludes mere fact or conclusion disputes. That is the opposite target from a factual-claim refutation. Item 77 also requires no quote and has different null rules (null only if both title and argument are missing).
